posts.text: Pleased to meet UK Foreign Secretary Yvette Cooper. India-UK Vision 2035 will continue to guide our partnership and strengthen our joint efforts for global good.

posts.text: Bring a strong BJP government in Bengal and infiltration will be completely stopped. Not even birds will be able to cross. I have written seven letters to Mamata Banerjee — land is not being given for border fencing. The 2026 Assembly elections will bring a massive mandate for BJP.

posts.text: Today, I will participate in the inauguration and foundation stone laying ceremony of 71 development projects, including the Flatted Factory Complex developed in the GIDA area at a cost of ₹208 crore and the EWS-LIG residential complex, in the holy city of Gorakhpur.

posts.text: Announced a Rs 151 crore grant to ICT, celebrating Professor Sharma's legacy. Even in a year when the world grew more fractured, Reliance remained anchored to an unwavering belief — India's future cannot wait. While others debated, we built.

posts.text: I have always believed that if you want to walk fast, walk alone. But if you want to walk far, walk together. The strength of India lies in its people and their ability to dream big and work hard to achieve those dreams.

posts.text: Every policy document and project file should ultimately serve the welfare of people. posts.text: The Conservative Party must return to its core values of lower taxes, less regulation, and strong defence. We need to offer a clear and compelling alternative to the current government's direction. That is what I will continue to fight for.

posts.text: Won the Ohio GOP gubernatorial primary. Ready to take on Amy Acton in the general election. Ohio needs a leader who understands that data centers, AI infrastructure, and innovation are key to our future — not something to fear. Let's build Ohio into America's next great technology hub.

posts.text: Proud to represent the Indian-American community in this role. My heritage has shaped my values of hard work, education, and service. Together, we are building a stronger and more inclusive America.

posts.text: The FBI under my leadership will continue to root out corruption and hold the deep state accountable. We are restoring law and order and making sure that every American is treated equally under the law.

posts.text: Australia's commitment to the Indo-Pacific region remains strong. We are deepening our engagement with India, investing in defence, clean energy, and technology partnerships that benefit both our nations.

posts.text: France is preparing to host the G7 summit later this month in Évian-les-Bains. We will work with our allies to address the conflict in the Middle East, climate action, and AI governance. Multilateralism is our best path forward.

posts.text: The Anthropic-SpaceX deal may be renewed at a lower price, the same price, a higher price or it may end. It's short-term because we might need the compute back. SpaceX IPO prospectus has the details — initial term is three months.

posts.text: Meta has pulled back from the metaverse to focus on AI. We acquired Manus for $2 billion to accelerate our commercial AI offerings. Building personalized AI agents is the next frontier — we are going all in on making AI that truly works for people.

posts.text: A huge thank you to our investors, including Berkshire Hathaway who invested $10B. We raised roughly $45 billion in the first leg of our equity offering, with another $40 billion expected through our at-the-market program. This is going straight into our AI compute build-out.

posts.text: What you just saw is a pretty significant shift. We believe the time has come for every company to move from consuming a frontier model to fully participating in the frontier ecosystem. AI agents are becoming the primary way people interact with technology.

posts.text: The US should lead on AI by continuing to develop the very best models, making sure they're safe, and getting cyber tools into the hands of trusted defenders. The new EO gets the balance right.

posts.text: The collaboration with Google is going well. We are happy with where things are, and we are happy with the work we are doing independently as well. WWDC is right around the corner — this is going to be one to watch. All systems glow.
